# `villager_voices.display` — common

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The action-bar display channel: the per-player villager_voices.display.DisplayQueue, its villager_voices.display.DisplayLine input, and the pure villager_voices.display.DisplayFormat (docs/spec/domains/display.md).

### `class DisplayFormat` — `common/src/main/java/villager_voices/display/DisplayFormat.java`
The action-bar text format (DISPLAY-REQ-004, docs/spec/domains/display.md §3 "Display format"): ": ", falling back to "Villager: " for a villager with no profession.
- `String format(String speakerLabel, String line)` — null/blank for a villager with no profession (nitwit, unemployed) speakerLabel is null or blank

### `record DisplayLine(String speakerLabel, String text, String soundId)` — `common/src/main/java/villager_voices/display/DisplayLine.java`
One line selected for display (docs/spec/domains/display.md §3 "Display format", DISPLAY-REQ-004).

### `class DisplayQueue` — `common/src/main/java/villager_voices/display/DisplayQueue.java`
Per-player FIFO queue absorbing the action bar's single-occupancy, last-write-wins behaviour (docs/spec/domains/display.md §3 "The per-player queue"; DISPLAY-DEC-002).
- `long DEFAULT_MIN_HOLD_TICKS` — Proposed default minimum hold time (docs/spec/domains/display.md §7: "1.5–2s proposed"), confirmed at this ticket as 1.5s: 30 ticks at Minecraft's fixed 20 ticks/second.
- `int DEFAULT_CAP_PER_PLAYER` — Default per-player backlog cap, confirmed at this ticket.
- `DisplayQueue()` — A queue using #DEFAULT_MIN_HOLD_TICKS and #DEFAULT_CAP_PER_PLAYER.
- `DisplayQueue(long minHoldTicks, int capPerPlayer)` — the next queued line for that player; display.queueMinHoldTicks's eventual config value (docs/spec/domains/display.md §3 "Config surface") feeds this constructor, not the reverse beyond it (DISPLAY-FAIL-002)
- `void enqueue(UUID playerId, DisplayLine line)` — Enqueues line for playerId.
- `Map<UUID, DisplayLine> tick(long nowTicks)` — Advances every player with a non-empty backlog whose current line (if any) has held for at least minHoldTicks, popping their next line and marking it shown as of nowTicks.
- `int pendingCount(UUID playerId)` — The number of lines still waiting behind whatever is currently shown for playerId.
- `DisplayLine current(UUID playerId)` — The line currently shown for playerId, or null if none has been pushed yet.
